name: palisade_tower
description: The Palisade kit's palisade_tower, rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 52.3 (tools/blueprints/briefs/palisade_tower.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes a candidate; ../palisade/selfcheck.py checks the kit's pins.

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py palisade_tower palisade_tower --candidate --nbt out/palisade-tower.nbt
